purpose: Runtime-neutral preload, cache, lifecycle, and recovery contract for the Dallas realistic 3D chibi library. This batch prepares production Gamecast consumption without modifying shared NFL runtime code or any MLB/NHL behavior.

initial: Resolve only active DAL participants for the selected game from the authoritative Gamecast participant set.
Preload each resolved participant base asset before optional actions.
Preload only roster.json-listed actions likely for the player's participant role; never preload an archetype superset absent from roster.json.
Preload verified signature assets only for CeeDee Lamb and Von Miller and only from signature-sequences-stars-01.json.
preloadPolicy.crossTeamGuard: A preload request is rejected unless canonical roster resolution returns team DAL.

cachePolicy.immutableAssetKey: resolved asset URL + versioned animation key
cachePolicy.reuse: Reuse decoded Dallas assets across plays in the same selected game; never re-decode solely because polling returned the same event.
eviction: Evict transient action references after game change.
Release decoded Dallas assets when leaving the selected NFL game unless another active NFL Gamecast consumer holds the same immutable key.
Never evict or mutate MLB/NHL caches from Dallas lifecycle cleanup.
cachePolicy.failureMemoization: Memoize a missing candidate for the current immutable version during the selected game so repeated polling does not hammer the same missing URL; continue fallback resolution.

lifecycle.gameSelect: Clear prior-game Dallas transient bindings, establish the new selected-game scope, then preload visible DAL participant bases.
lifecycle.playStart: Resolve canonical participants and warm requested action candidates before transition selection when possible.
lifecycle.playUpdate: Apply gamecast-integration-02 fingerprint and ordering guards; identical polling payloads cannot restart animation or duplicate preload work.
lifecycle.playEnd: Return animated players to locked bottom-center anchors, release transient possession, retain reusable decoded assets for the selected game.
lifecycle.gameEnd: Allow the final animation to settle, then release transient state; cache cleanup follows consumer-reference rules.
lifecycle.routeExit: Destroy Dallas transient bindings/listeners and release unreferenced Dallas decoded assets without touching other sport namespaces.

renderReadiness.rule: A missing optional action or signature never blocks the existing Gamecast presentation. If base is unavailable, retain the existing non-chibi presentation for that player.
renderReadiness.swapRule: Do not swap a lower-priority fallback for a newly decoded higher-priority asset mid-animation unless the next event/transition boundary selects it; avoid visible popping.

appearanceAndGeometryInvariants.appearanceAuthority: Dallas appearance-reference lock sourced from current official player headshots; never infer skin tone or visible appearance from a name
appearanceAndGeometryInvariants.continuity: Base, action, and verified-signature assets for a player must preserve identity, uniform geometry, number, scale, camera, lighting, and anchor.

telemetryContract.privacy: Record canonical roster slug/action keys and technical status only; no user-identifying data.
telemetryContract.nonBlocking: Telemetry failure must never block rendering or animation selection.

checks: Preload selection remains roster.json-authoritative and team-isolated.
Repeated polling cannot duplicate decode work or restart active animation.
Missing optional assets fail soft and do not blank Gamecast.
Failure memoization avoids repeated missing-file probes within the same immutable version/game scope.
Verified named signatures remain limited to Lamb nose-wipe and Miller DeSoto Shuffle.
Appearance, number, camera, lighting, scale, alpha, and foot-anchor locks remain invariant.
Lifecycle cleanup is scoped to NFL Dallas chibi state and cannot mutate MLB/NHL caches or renderers.
This batch is metadata-only and introduces no shared runtime behavior change.
